project_type: Python FastAPI + Jinja2 investment analysis platform (Bloomberg-style dashboard)
verification_instructions: Run pytest tests/ -x -q to ensure all 448 existing tests pass. Do NOT modify any test files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Python 3.11 default. Do NOT modify files in tests/ directory.
contribution_requirements: Commit messages in Chinese. Push directly to main. Version 7.6.0 -> 7.7.0. No external frontend frameworks.
key_patterns: Templates extend base.html. Bloomberg dark theme CSS in static/css/bloomberg.css. API routes in dashboard/app.py. Core logic in src/augur/. Personas defined in PERSONA_ENRICHMENT dict. Data sources in src/augur/datasources/. i18n via data-i18n attributes and static/js/i18n.js.
directory_structure: dashboard/ (app.py, templates/, static/), src/augur/ (core logic, personas, bots, datasources), tests/, docs/, personas/ (YAML definitions), config/
